title: AggregateDistributedGenerationA
description: Parameters of the DERA1 model in PSS/E It has no bus of its own: exactly one static injection device, with the same name, names it in its `dynamic_injector` property, and that device supplies the rest of its data.

id.description: Unique integer identifier for this component.

name.description: Name of the dynamic injection. Must equal the name of the static injection device that names it in `dynamic_injector`.

PQ_Flag.description: Flag used to enforce maximum current

Gen_Flag.description: Flag to specify generator or storage

Vtrip_Flag.description: Flag to enable/disable voltage trip logic

Ftrip_Flag.description: Flag to enable/disable frequency trip logic

T_rv.description: Voltage measurement transducer time constant Units: s.

Trf.description: Frequency measurement transducer time constant Units: s.

Tp.description: Power measurement transducer time constant Units: s.

T_iq.description: Time constant for low-pass filter for state q_V when QFlag = 0 Units: s.

D_dn.description: Reciprocal of droop for over-frequency conditions (>0) (pu)

D_up.description: Reciprocal of droop for under-frequency conditions <=0) (pu)

dP_lim.description: Power reference ramp rate limits (dPmin, dPmax)

Tpord.description: Power filter time constant Units: s.

I_max.description: Maximum limit on total converter current (pu)

vl_pnts.description: Low voltage cutout points `[(tv10, vl0), (tv11, vl1)]`

vh_pnts.description: High voltage cutout points `[(tvh0, vh0), (tvh1, vh1)]`

Vrfrac.description: Fraction of device that recovers after voltage comes back to within vl1 < V < vh1 (0 <= Vrfrac <= 1)

fl.description: Inverter frequency break-point for low frequency cut-out (Hz) Units: Hz.

fh.description: Inverter frequency break-point for high frequency cut-out (Hz) Units: Hz.

tfl.description: Low frequency cut-out timer corresponding to frequency fl (s) Units: s.

tfh.description: High frequency cut-out timer corresponding to frequency fh (s) Units: s.

Tg.description: Current control time constant (to represent behavior of inner control loops) (> 0) (s) Units: s.

rrpwr.description: Ramp rate for real power increase following a fault (pu/s)

Tv.description: Time constant on the output of the multiplier (s) Units: s.

Vpr.description: Voltage below which frequency tripping is disabled (pu) Units: pu.

V_ref.description: User defined voltage reference. If 0, `PowerSimulationsDynamics.jl` initializes to initial terminal voltage

Q_ref.description: Reference reactive power, in pu Units: pu.

P_ref.description: Reference active power, in pu Units: pu.

base_power.description: Base power for the per-unit parameters of this model. Usually equal to the `base_power` of the static injection device that names this model. Units: MVA.
